views.prompt: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of a 29-year-old Russian lab technician: tall and lanky, messy light brown hair, short stubble, friendly face; a dark green hooded zip jacket over a faded grey t-shirt, loose khaki cargo trousers, black running shoes. Plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, no props, no bag, no text, photorealistic, realistic body proportions.
